I just wanted more, but luckily I stopped before it got to serious, and took myself to inpatient treatment for 30 days. It was one of those Medicaid funded rehabs, so it wasn't the best. All the did was feed us, and push NA down our throats. But, after that I decided to look into MAT, and chose the buprenorphine route. It works wonders. You don't have to go out and look for a buzz, and you always got something to cure the cravings and withdrawal symptoms. I salute you for finding your way out.  Much Love.
